name: Benzedrone
summary: Benzedrone (4-MBC) is a designer drug which has been found since 2010 as an ingredient in a number of "bath salt" mixes sold as recreational drugs.

uses.text: Benzedrone (4-MBC) is a designer drug which has been found since 2010 as an ingredient in a number of "bath salt" mixes sold as recreational drugs.

pharmacology.en: Its action has not been studied in detail. Cathinones of this kind generally make nerve cells release dopamine and noradrenaline or block their reuptake, which produces stimulant effects.
pharmacology.zh: 它的作用機制未經詳細研究。這類卡西酮一般會促使神經細胞釋放多巴胺與正腎上腺素，或阻斷其回收，從而產生興奮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的作用机制未经详细研究。这类卡西酮一般会促使神经细胞释放多巴胺与正肾上腺素，或阻断其回收，从而产生兴奋作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, and carry a high risk of compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮、妄想與精神病，並有高度的強迫性連續補用與成癮風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成卡西酮可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、失眠、焦虑、妄想与精神病，并有高度的强迫性连续补用与成瘾风险。

fact.en: Its name is a blend of Benzedrine and mephedrone, which is apt: it is mephedrone with a benzyl group in place of the methyl on the ring.
fact.zh: 它的名稱是 Benzedrine 與 mephedrone 的混合，這相當貼切：它就是把 mephedrone 環上的甲基換成苄基的產物。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称是 Benzedrine 与 mephedrone 的混合，这相当贴切：它就是把 mephedrone 环上的甲基换成苄基的产物。
